description: [Read · free] Which of your posts bring in DMs, leads and clients, next to which get engagement. Reads the inbound outcomes logged with log_outcome (inbound_dm | lead | client) for one of your tracked profiles over the last `days` (default 90). Returns totals, top_by_outcomes (posts credited with at least one outcome), top_by_engagement (your most-engaged posts in the window, with their outcome counts, so the two rankings can be compared), by_format, and the unattributed outcomes still waiting for a post (fix with log_outcome outcome_id + post_url). Engagement is not used to attribute: outcomes are matched by post_url, message text and timing. Free — costs 0 credits.
